patterns: until what time are you open
responses: Our online store is open 24/7. Customer support is available Monday–Saturday, 9:00–21:00, and our showroom is open daily 10:00–22:00.

patterns: how long until i get my package
responses: Standard delivery takes 3–5 business days. Express delivery (1–2 business days) is available at checkout for most items.

patterns: how much do you charge for delivery
is delivery free over a certain amount
responses: Shipping is free on orders over $50. Below that, standard shipping is $4.99 and express is $9.99.

do you ship to the uk

which countries do you ship to
can i get it sent to germany
responses: Yes, we ship to 40+ countries. International delivery takes 7–14 business days; costs and any customs fees are shown at checkout.

patterns: how do i return an item
i want to return my order
i don't like the product can i return it
how to get a return label
responses: You can return most items within 30 days of delivery for a full refund, as long as they're in original condition. Start a return from My Orders → Return item, and we'll email you a free return label.

patterns: when will i get my refund
responses: Refunds are issued within 2 business days after we receive your return. Your bank may take 5–10 business days to show it.

patterns: what payment methods do you accept
can i pay cash on delivery
responses: We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay and cash on delivery (orders under $500).

patterns: my device is broken under warranty
the screen cracked, is it covered
device stopped charging after a month
responses: All products come with a 1-year manufacturer warranty. You can add Nova Care+ to extend it to 3 years. To make a claim, visit Support → Warranty claim with your order number.

patterns: do you have the iphone in stock
when will it be back in stock
will you get more stock soon
when do you get new stock
can i preorder the new phone
responses: Stock levels are shown live on each product page. If an item is out of stock, click 'Notify me' and we'll email you the moment it's back. We sell phones, laptops, audio, gaming, smart home and accessories.

patterns: is there a sale this weekend
responses: Check our Deals page for current offers. New subscribers get 10% off their first order, and students get 5% with a verified student email.

patterns: do you have a physical store
responses: Our showroom is at 120 Market Street, Downtown, open daily 10:00–22:00. You can also choose free in-store pickup at checkout.

patterns: how do i create an account
how do i sign up for an account
i didn't get the verification email
responses: To reset your password, click 'Forgot password' on the login page and follow the email link. For other account changes go to My Account → Settings.

patterns: how do i cancel an order
i changed my mind about my order
cancel the purchase i made today
responses: Orders can be cancelled free of charge until they ship. Go to My Orders → Cancel. If it has already shipped, you can return it within 30 days instead.

patterns: can i change the address on my order
send it to a different address
responses: You can change the delivery address from My Orders → Edit address until the order ships. After that, contact support and we'll try to redirect it.

patterns: can you match a competitor price
will you beat a competitor price
i saw a better price online
responses: Yes — we match the price of major authorised retailers on identical in-stock items. Contact support with a link to the offer before you buy.

patterns: how do i use a gift card
buy a gift card for a friend

responses: Digital gift cards from $10 to $500 are available on our Gift Cards page. Enter the code at checkout to use it, and check its balance under My Account → Gift cards.
